one_liner: Unified spend platform with public API and official MCP server.
access_notes: Any Brex customer can enable the Developer API and create personal access (user) tokens from the Brex dashboard; the official MCP server is available and currently in beta, which can be enabled by an account admin.
mcp_notes: Official Brex MCP server at https://api.brex.com/mcp (beta).
blocker_notes: None; Brex customers can self-serve create PATs and start using the REST API without partner approval or sales.
